title: DTN: key the per-source admission cap on the LLSec-authenticated peer IID
description: Follow-up from cxa2 (security pass 2, P1-as-filed): the per-source admission cap added to lichen_router_dtn_buffer is keyed on the CLAIMED wire IPv6 source IID (view.source) — route_packet has no link-auth context. An authenticated insider rotating source IIDs per S-flagged store defeats the cap (per_source always 0). Fix direction: thread the L2-authenticated sender IID into struct lichen_route_packet (like the Rust receive path carries sender_iid) and key both the cap and the stored record on it; for relayed traffic the authenticated sender is the relaying neighbor (legitimately differs from the originator — decide whether quota follows the relayer or the originator). Requires a struct lichen_route_packet API change across callers. router.h documents the reduced threat model meanwhile.
